known_facts_book1: A little boy in a brown velvet jacket and knickerbockers, brown stockings, buckled shoes and a frilled blue shirt-waist, half a head shorter than Trot and younger than she is.
His home used to be in Philadelphia, but he has lost his Magic Umbrella that used to carry him anywhere and considers that he belongs nowhere.
Has been in the Land of Oz before and once left it in one of the Wizard's big bubbles.
Is found in the Land of Mo buried in a bank of popcorn snow, eating it, and asks only for his cap when pulled out.
Is almost destitute of nerves: nothing astonishes him, worries him or makes him unhappy, and he accepts good or bad fortune with a quiet smile.
Gets lost repeatedly — chasing a butterfly in Jinxland, again before breakfast on coronation day, and again at Ozma's banquet.
Is rescued in Jinxland by the Ork, who spots him from the air and carries him back to Pon's hut.
Is the one who spots the cave behind the Great Waterfall where the drowned Scarecrow can be found.
Is found at the coronation feast beating the bass drum with a turkey-leg bone he had eaten clean.
Ozma's last words of the book are that if Button-Bright is not lost occasionally, he is not happy.

known_relations_book1.Trot: An old friend from their journey to Sky Island; they hold hands walking.
known_relations_book1.Cap'n Bill: Likes the boy for being cheerful, brave and willing.
known_relations_book1.the Ork: The creature who finds him lost in Jinxland and carries him back.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Who already knew him from his earlier visit to Oz.

not_in_this_book: Button-Bright still has his Magic Umbrella
Button-Bright is never lost in this book

known_facts_book1: A creature with four stork-like legs, four wings shaped like inverted chopping-bowls and covered with tough skin instead of feathers, a poll-parrot head with a half-bill half-mouth, and a scarlet crest of wavy plumes.
Its tail is shaped like a boat or airship propeller, pivoted to its body, and it flies by whirling that tail; its wings only support it in the air.
Weighs about as much as Cap'n Bill and can carry one passenger between its wings, or two for a short distance.
Comes from Orkland, where the Orks are absolute rulers of all living things from ants to elephants; his father called him 'Flipper'.
Left home without saying good-bye, lost all track of direction, and was sucked into the same whirlpool as Trot and Cap'n Bill.
Is burned by a candle he carries in his claw and complains that it bit him.
Eats a lavender berry on Pessim's island and shrinks to the size of a bumblebee, and is restored by a dark purple berry.
Finds Orkland at last, is welcomed with a great celebration, and comes back anyway when his friends are in danger.
Brings fifty Orks whose whirling tails scatter King Krewl's bonfire so that not one burning brand touches the Scarecrow, blow the King against his own castle wall and hang Googly-Goo in a tree.
Crowns the Scarecrow with Krewl's fallen crown, and has his followers find Blinkie hiding under a bush and drag her to the throne.
Carries the four travellers over the mountains into the Land of Oz by moonlight, and leaves without waiting to be thanked, being due at a surprise party for his uncle.

known_relations_book1.Trot: Carries her out of the caverns, over the desert and finally into Oz.
known_relations_book1.Cap'n Bill: Says he would recognize him anywhere by his wooden leg.
known_relations_book1.Button-Bright: Finds him lost in Jinxland and flies him back to Pon's hut.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Whom his flock saves from the bonfire and crowns King of Jinxland.
known_relations_book1.King Krewl: The King his flock blows off his throne and pins to the ground.
known_relations_book1.Pessim: The little man whose island he escapes from.

not_in_this_book: the Ork stays in the Land of Oz

hallucination_signals: the Ork never finds his home
